0.description: A great threat to the peace here in the Shroud has made itself known, and I have been sent to help drive it out. Adventurer or no, I will not suffer anyone interfering with my work. Now please, move along.

1.description: We were fortunate the curator of that damnable place was careless enough to leave his notes where we might find them. Perhaps now we can discover his true motives.
